title: Use moto as an app
samsungDescription: Do not install moto through Samsung Internet. Open moto in Chrome and sign in there.
samsungFallback: If this does not work, open Chrome and go to {host}.
oneTapDescription: Install moto directly from this page. moto will then always open full screen, without a browser bar.
androidBefore: Open the browser menu and tap
installTooltip: Installs moto as an app; your device asks you first.
openInChromeTooltip: Opens this page in Chrome, where you can install moto.
closeTooltip: Hides this hint on this device for good.
